explication: Konnect is a native KiCad plugin/server that exposes PCB-design operations to AI assistants through MCP. The principal workflow is an assistant request entering through stdio or HTTP, being dispatched to an on-demand toolset, and then editing a schematic or live PCB or running a check/export before returning a result. The README also documents component search, reference circuits, live viewing, and Specctra autorouting, which appear as distinct branches. The excerpts support the server dispatch, IPC client, S-expression parser, and Freerouting orchestration; some tool wiring is documented but its implementation was not sampled.
